aliases: ミラージュフラッシュ
official_definition: Once per turn, by putting a core from the Void to your Life, activate a Flash effect of your Color(/Color2) Magic card Mirage, besides any "During Set" effects, without paying the cost.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Mirage Flash] or [Mirage Flash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Mirage Flash]", "give [Mirage Flash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
